measurement_rules.full_cell: Before per-cell input/prompt checks through owner close. Includes startup, CLI, all tools/errors/fallback, final and cleanup. Subsequent cell-accounting publication is in batch wall, not each cell.
measurement_rules.consumer: Recorded consumer monotonic origin through reader/bridge cleanup; includes CLI startup, model/API waiting, tool work and cleanup. Not pure model reasoning.
measurement_rules.batch: run_models entry through last per-cell publication; excludes final timing-summary publication and caller overhead. Initial batch-setup failure may lack end record.
measurement_rules.tokens: Public turn.completed actual usage; cached input is a subset of input, reasoning output is a subset of output. Total=input+output only. No sum of duplicate usage rows.
measurement_rules.public_bytes: Actual TX.bin/RX.bin lengths include JSON framing/newline; catalogue and handshake separated. Decoded content text UTF-8 bytes are different, not added again.
measurement_rules.internal_bytes: Product stdio RPC frames separate from public MCP frames. Worker script/stdout archival bytes are not measured TCP wire bytes or model input tokens.
measurement_rules.tool_time: Owner and consumer-public tool intervals overlap the full wall and one another across levels. Sum and interval union both reported; never added to full-cell time.
measurement_rules.first_sufficient_fact: Manual evidence-based timestamp of earliest completed public call furnishing all mandatory task facts, accounting for accumulated previous calls. Subsequent optional evidence, model/provider waiting and final generation are retained. It is not pure reasoning or all removable latency.
measurement_rules.retries: All attempted tool calls retained, including corrections/fallback. No replacement sessions. Observed stderr retry markers and same-argument repeats are listed; internal provider attempts are unexposed.
measurement_rules.unknowns: Dollar fees, provider request counts, per-call tokens, pure reasoning time, and native TCP bytes remain unknown. Pro subscription usage is not converted into API dollars.
measurement_rules.thin_exit: All missing thin-client EXIT receipts remain unknown; independent owner/worker close confirmation is reported separately.

nearest_followup.interpretation: Six follow-up spatial_relations calls request witnesses (and sometimes relation/AABB). Their directly measured tool time and bytes are real; nearest-to-final spans include model/provider waits, additional facts and final-answer construction, and are not a predicted time saving. Per-call usage cannot be split from session totals.

historical_record.scope: One-time preparation, not consumer or product speed. Measured interval starts at first captured local CLI command, so earlier reading/analysis is unmeasured; it includes later coding/review/waits and failed probes, and is not pure execution CPU time. Final archive/index/Git verification after this timestamp remains outside this measured window.
historical_record.T1_original_failed_preparation_and_later: tasks/T1/run_01/PREPARATION_RESULT.json and CERTIFICATION_RESULT.json; separate wall time includes QA development, not just certifier subsecond duration
historical_record.caution: Task generation, independent truth and experimental setup are displayed separately from per-task consumer/full-cell outcomes; no claimed net benefit before sampling.

one_time_preparation.comparison_caution: 3018.7268128 seconds is the earlier preparation window including coding/review/waits and failed probes, not this model batch.
